fonts.display: 'PolySans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Electric Violet
palette.role: Primary action background, filled CTA buttons, active link borders, selected badge strokes — the single saturated chromatic that drives every conversion and active state

palette.name: Midnight Plum
palette.role: Headline text color, display-weight typography — deep violet-ink that reads as near-black but carries a violet undertone matching the primary

palette.name: Obsidian Charcoal
palette.role: Body text, paragraph copy, list items, icon strokes, default borders and dividers — the workhorse neutral that defines almost all interface line work

palette.name: Slate Smoke
palette.role: Secondary body text, muted helper copy, supporting metadata

palette.name: Pearl Mist
palette.role: Hairline borders on buttons, cards, and inputs; subtle structural dividers

palette.name: Soft Concrete
palette.role: Subtle surface fills, secondary button backgrounds, disabled or recessed controls

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page and card surfaces, button text on violet fills, nav-pill and elevated panel backgrounds

palette.name: Sky Tint
palette.role: Decorative pastel accent — painterly background fills, soft highlight washes, illustrative splashes

palette.name: Lime Spritz
palette.role: Decorative pastel accent — painterly background fills, squiggle underline fills, product card surface variation

palette.name: Cotton Candy
palette.role: Decorative pastel accent — soft pink washes, squiggle underline highlights, atmospheric card backgrounds

palette.name: Neon Cyan
palette.role: Badge stroke and informational icon accent — vivid, used in tag outlines and feature flags

palette.name: Lime Pop
palette.role: Badge stroke and positive/success-leaning icon accent — vivid green used in tag outlines

palette.name: Magenta Pulse
palette.role: Badge stroke and energetic icon accent — hot pink for tag outlines and feature highlights
